vendtermallowed.title: Vendor Termination Allowed
vendtermallowed.remarks: Checking this box indicates that early termination is allowed by vendor.

paymentsched.title: Payment Schedule
paymentsched.remarks: Checking this box indicates a there is a defined payment schedule.

insuranceexpdate.title: Insurance Expiration Date
insuranceexpdate.remarks: Expiration date of the vendors insurance policy.

customernum.title: Customer #
customernum.remarks: The unique number issued by the vendor to identify our company.

autoextendperiod.title: Extension Period
autoextendperiod.remarks: If the contract is extendable, this field indicates the auto extend period in days.

purchaseagent.title: Buyer
purchaseagent.remarks: The current buyer, or purchasing agent listed on this contract.

currencycode.title: Currency
currencycode.remarks: Indicates the currency used to satisfy monetary transactions associated with this contract.

startdate.title: Start Date
startdate.remarks: The date on which the contract becomes active.

vendorrefnum.title: Vendor Reference #
vendorrefnum.remarks: A unique identification code issued to a vendor.

totalcost.title: Total Cost
totalcost.remarks: The sum of all the costs on the contract lines on the current contract.

buyahead.title: Buy Ahead
buyahead.remarks: Is this a buy ahead rate, ie entered directly by the user and not calculated from the list of active exchange rate.

contact.title: Contact
contact.remarks: The name of the person employed by the vendor to contact with queries about this contract.

renewaldate.title: Renewal Date
renewaldate.remarks: Date that the contract can or must be be renewed to remain active.

shippingloss.title: Shipping Loss
shippingloss.remarks: Checking this box indicates you are liable for shipping loss.

addlinesonuse.title: Add Lines on Use
addlinesonuse.remarks: Checking this box indicates you can add lines to the purchase document with contract reference.

inclusive5.title: Include Tax 5
inclusive5.remarks: Is the PO total inclusive of Tax 5.

inclusive4.title: Include Tax 4
inclusive4.remarks: Is the PO total inclusive of Tax 4.

enforcebundle.title: Maintain Hierarchy
enforcebundle.remarks: Checking this box indicates that bundling is enforced.

chgqtyonuse.title: Change Quantity on Use
chgqtyonuse.remarks: Can quantity be changed on line with contract reference.

acceptperiod.title: Acceptance Period
acceptperiod.remarks: Amount of time in days that can pass before the buyer must either accept the received items or return them.

processclaim.title: PROCESS CLAIM
processclaim.remarks: Can a claim be processed against this contract

changedate.title: Changed Date
changedate.remarks: The date on which the contract was last altered.

hasinsurance.title: Has Insurance
hasinsurance.remarks: Does this vendor have a current insurance policy ?

inclusive1.title: Pay Tax to Vendor
inclusive1.remarks: Is the PO total inclusive of Tax 1

inclusive3.title: Include Tax 3
inclusive3.remarks: Is the PO total inclusive of Tax 3.

inclusive2.title: Include Tax 2
inclusive2.remarks: Is the PO total inclusive of Tax 2.

inspectionrequired.title: Inspection Required
inspectionrequired.remarks: Checking this box indicates that items ordered from this company must be inspected on receipt.

shipvia.title: Ship Via
shipvia.remarks: The name of the shipping company to use for transporting items associated withthis contract.

enddate.title: End Date
enddate.remarks: Date after which the contract is no longer valid.

contracttype.title: Type
contracttype.remarks: Indicator of the current contract type.

createrel.title: Create Release
createrel.remarks: Checking this box indicates you can createa release from the contract.

fob.title: FOB Point
fob.remarks: The point at which merchandise is on board a vehicle and in transit.

extendable.title: Extendable
extendable.remarks: Checking this box indicates the contract is extendable.

custtermallowed.title: Customer Termination Allowed
custtermallowed.remarks: Checking this box indicates that early termination by the customer is allowed.

porequired.title: Requires PO
porequired.remarks: Checking this box indicates a PO is required for this contract.

chgpriceonuse.title: Change Price on Use
chgpriceonuse.remarks: Can price be changed on the line with contract reference.

paymentterms.title: Payment Terms
paymentterms.remarks: The agreed upon terms related to monetary payments associated with this contract.

exchangerate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangerate.remarks: Exchange rate the time of contract approval.

totalbasecost.title: Total Base Cost
totalbasecost.remarks: Cost of the entire contract in base currency 1.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Description of the current purchase contract.

acceptanceloss.title: Acceptance Loss
acceptanceloss.remarks: Checking this box indicates you are liable for acceptance loss.

canexceedvolume.title: Can Exceed Amount
canexceedvolume.remarks: Checking this box indicates you can exceed the specified maximum amount on this contract.

exchangerate2.title: Exchange Rate2
exchangerate2.remarks: Exchange rate2 at the time of contract approval.

maxrelvol.title: Maximum Release Amount
maxrelvol.remarks: The total cost that a single REL type PO can have against this contract.

vendor.title: Company
vendor.remarks: A unique code indicating the vendor of the current purchase contract.

contractnum.title: Contract
contractnum.remarks: Unique ID Number for the current purchase contract.

maxvol.title: Maximum Amount
maxvol.remarks: Either the maximum monetary amount for a contract, or an estimate depending on how the'CANEXCEEDVOLUME' property is set.

amtremaining.title: Amount Remaining
amtremaining.remarks: Difference between the maximum volume and the commited cost for a volume specified contract.

vendnotifyperiod.title: Vendor Notification Period
vendnotifyperiod.remarks: If early termination is allowed by vendor, this indicates the notice of termination in days.

description_longdescription.title: Details
description_longdescription.remarks: A detailed description of the current purchase contract.

revcomments.title: Revision Comments
revcomments.remarks: Comments associated with the current revision of this contract.

changeby.title: Changed By
changeby.remarks: The login name of the person who last changed the contract.

custnotifyperiod.title: Customer Notification Period
custnotifyperiod.remarks: If early termination by the customer is allowed this is the customer notification period in days.

revisionnum.title: Revision
revisionnum.remarks: Revision number of the contract. This number indicates the number of times the contract has been revised. A contract that has been created and not revised will show a number of 0.

statusiface.title: Has Status Changed
statusiface.remarks: Non persistent boolean field to indicate whether the status has been changed after the stateful object is fetched from the database.

freightterms.title: Freight Terms
freightterms.remarks: The agreed upon terms related to shipping and receiving associated with this contract.

condforext.title: Conditions for Extension
condforext.remarks: Details any conditions that may exist for an extension.

masternum.title: Master Contract
masternum.remarks: The unique identification number of a Master Contract from which this contract was created.

np_statusmemo.title: Change Status Memo
np_statusmemo.remarks: Status change memo, temporary non-persistent field used by MEA
